bibl.title: Between Hera and Heroine: The Virginity, Marriages, and Queenship of Berenike II.
bibl.seg: Alex McAuley, Between Hera and Heroine: The Virginity, Marriages, and Queenship of Berenike II.

Christophe Cusset, Pierre Belanfont & Claire-Emmanuelle Nardone (edd.), Féminités hellénistiques: voix, genre, représentations = Hellenistica Groningana. 25 (Leuven - Paris - Bristol, CT, 2020) pp. 177-194.
bibl.note: Argues that the paradoxical aspects of Berenike's image (virginity before her marriage to Ptolemy III and identification as the sister of her husband, although she was not) are the product of an effort by the Ptolemaic court to identify Berenike II with the goddess Hera.
